## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Mixed-case writes should be fixed because the new setter stores keys that the case-insensitive lookup cannot retrieve.

## Changes
The pull request adds `Cache.set`, raises the default TTL to 300 seconds, and adds round-trip and expiry tests.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/cache.py:27 — correctness — Normalize mixed-case keys in set — Calling `set("ALPHA", 1)` followed by `get("ALPHA")` returns `None`. The setter stores the original key, while `get()` lowercases it, violating the case-insensitive contract documented at `app/cache.py:14`. — Callers writing mixed-case keys cannot retrieve their cached values, and mixed-case updates leave existing lowercase values unchanged.
